heard: Jupiter creates the largest structure in the solar system. Its invisible magnetic tail stretches all the way to Saturn. Deep inside turning metallic hydrogen drives this giant magnetic bubble. Volcanic eruptions on its moon Io feed it charged particles continuously. Jupiter spins in 10 hours, driving permanent polar auroras. These glowing lights are 100 times more powerful than Earth's. Magnetic lines even etch moon footprint spots into Jupiter's atmosphere. NASA's Juno spacecraft dives through polar orbits to avoid dangerous radiation. That is how we mapped the largest structure in the solar system.
